name: Dr Mei Tanaka
quote: Most people who come to me worried about a mole were right to have it checked, and most of the moles are fine. Both things are true.
bio: Mei runs Aurevia's skin clinic, including full-body mole checks with dermoscopic photography, so that a mole can be compared precisely against its own image a year later rather than against memory.

She also sees inflammatory skin conditions that have lingered through several treatments. Her clinic is unhurried by design: a proper skin check takes time, and it is the part of the visit she is least willing to shorten.
background: Dermatology training, with a specialist interest in dermoscopy and skin cancer surveillance.
